name: clio-data
description: The clio-data agent's plugin: its mission, assess-data-quality (what a variable states, checks, comparisons, visual checks) and convert-scientific-data (the HDF5/ADIOS2 to Parquet dtype map, skip-or-ask rules, and a bundled converter that reads back and verifies rows, nulls, NaNs, dtypes and per-column checksums).
